root_cause.text: An off-by-one bounds check in `drivers/tty/hvc/hvc_iucv.c:hvc_iucv_get_private()` used `num > hvc_iucv_devices` instead of `num >= hvc_iucv_devices`, allowing `hvc_iucv_table` to be indexed at `hvc_iucv_devices` even though valid entries are only `0..hvc_iucv_devices-1`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` to `if (num >= hvc_iucv_devices)`, and the CVE/commit explicitly states that `hvc_iucv_table` has `MAX_HVC_IUCV_LINES == 8` entries while `hvc_iucv_devices` can be `8`, so the old check allowed access to `hvc_iucv_table[8]`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix an off-by-one bounds check in hvc_iucv_get_private() to prevent out-of-range table access.
intent_record.what: The boundary check in hvc_iucv_get_private() was changed from `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` to `if (num >= hvc_iucv_devices)`, so the function now rejects an index equal to `hvc_iucv_devices` in addition to larger values.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents the function from treating `num == hvc_iucv_devices` as a valid index and accessing `hvc_iucv_table[num]` out of bounds; instead it returns NULL for that case, avoiding invalid memory access.

grouping_result.intent: Fix an off-by-one bounds check in hvc_iucv_get_private() to prevent out-of-range table access.

relevance_review.reason: The group's stated change exactly matches the vulnerability root cause: it fixes the off-by-one bounds check in hvc_iucv_get_private() that could allow indexing hvc_iucv_table at hvc_iucv_devices.

candidates.rationale: This bounds check is off by one: it permits num == hvc_iucv_devices, even though valid indices are only 0..hvc_iucv_devices-1, allowing an out-of-range access.
This statement performs the table access using num after the incorrect bounds check, so when num == hvc_iucv_devices it reads past the end of hvc_iucv_table.

vuln_statements.explanation: This is the root cause: the bounds check is off by one. It rejects only values greater than hvc_iucv_devices, but incorrectly allows num == hvc_iucv_devices, even though valid indices are 0..hvc_iucv_devices-1.
This statement performs the out-of-bounds table access after the incorrect bounds check. When num == hvc_iucv_devices, it indexes one past the last valid entry of hvc_iucv_table.
